title: Chapter 86
content_en: MGA: Chapter 86 – Mysterious ExpertWithin the core zone, in a flower garden within a certain residence. Leng Wuzui was currently feeding a Fierce Beast.It was a rank 9 Fierce Beast and it was as large as an elephant. It looked like a gorilla but its sharp teeth were very fierce. However, in front of Leng Wuzui, the Fierce Beast was abnormally cute.It was just obediently eating the food on the ground and did not attack Leng Wuzui. It even let Leng Wuzui stroke its fur and it did not have any reactions.It was not that the Fierce Beast had spiritual nature and lost its violent instincts. It was just deeply suppressed by Leng Wuzui’s power and became his pet. A pet that was subdued by power.“Junior Leng, the person you wanted to find has been found.”...
